We report the discovery of localized, chemically rich regions near the bases of the two-lobe bipolar molecular outflow in HOPS 87 containing molecules such as H 2 CO, [13] CS, H 2 S, OCS, and CH 3 OH, the simplest complex organic molecule (COM).
In this paper, we report newly discovered, localized, chemically rich regions associated with jet-driven shocks near the two bases of the bipolar outflow in the protostellar core HOPS 87.
